payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates over all valid multiplicity assignments for each distinct digit (1..count) via Cartesian product, then computes number of valid permutations (no leading zero) using combinatorics.
payload.rationale: The solution performs complete search over all possible digit frequency distributions (multisets) that use each distinct digit at least once and at most its total count. For each, it uses permutation formula to count distinct numbers without leading zero. This is akin to enumerating permutations indirectly by first enumerating the multiset compositions.
